QUOTE: "Index thread inventory: 4 spawn sites, all first-party, all in `programs/` ... None are in `library/`."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states that no thread spawns exist in library/, but it frames library/'s mutex code as inert by default, not as the mutex abstraction supplied for threaded callers. It never states that library/ supplies the abstraction, so the second half of the contrast is missing.
